alt: June 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of the Charminar in Hyderabad, its four minarets and great arch under a blue sky, with autorickshaws and people on the street below. Bakrid is marked.
caption: Watercolor illustration of a historic gate for the June 2025 calendar
description: A soft watercolor rendering of a grand Mughal-style gateway with two tall minarets and crenellated walls set against a blue and gold sky wash. The scene includes a street with small figures, trees, and auto-rickshaws under the arch. A calendar grid for June 2025 appears below the artwork, with the sixth day marked as Bakrid.
